collectables.menu.modal_marker_trbl.meta: Fully power off your console. For best results, unplug the power cable and wait at least 30 seconds before plugging it back in.
On the console home screen, launch the game. As soon as the screen goes black, hold (PlayStation: L1 + R1) / (Xbox: RB + LB).

You will need to reconfigure your game settings afterward.
For a detailed guide with screenshots, please refer to:

Completely close the game and the Rockstar Games Launcher.
In this folder, you will see one or more subfolders named after your profile ID(s). Open the relevant profile folder.
Inside the selected profile folder, delete the file named Player.
Relaunch the game and check if the issue is resolved.
collectables.menu.modal_marker_trbl.miss: These leftover items do not affect the current cycle. That means you can collect the same item twice in one cycle. Be aware: Changing sessions or using fast travel will despawn them.

If you've come across an item that doesn't appear on today's map, it's likely a leftover spawn from a previous cycle. These items are only visible to you and cannot be found by other players. You can collect them by switching the map view to the previous day's cycle — a known but harmless glitch that occasionally occurs between sessions (a buggy bonus from Rockstar).
If you're missing an item or suspect the map cycle is incorrect, please follow the steps below. (If the issue is resolved after the first two steps, you may disregard the remaining ones.)
Switch sessions 1–2 times via the in-game menu. Ensure you are not placed back into the same session.
Exit the game completely and turn off your console.
Unplug the power cable for at least 30 seconds.
Plug it back in and launch the game again.
Exit both the game and the Rockstar Games Launcher.
Delete all files with the .dat extension.
